notes.title: Update - Version 1.02
notes.content:
Update version 1.02 is now available!

With this update, we now have Chinese language support (Traditional/Simplified) in the game.
The game can now be played fully in Chinese!

Also included within this update are a few quality of life improvements.
You can now set up Rooms for online battles, which allow players to set up private or public rooms for coordinated matches.

For players who have been having issues running to game smoothly, the long-requested low graphics option is now available!

Players can now move during the Ready phase of battle in order to take up strategic positions for the start of battle.
Additionally, a few additional balancing adjustments were made to make battling fairer.

See the detailed patch notes below:

[h2]Language support[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36386796/f67f9b7d3e578b226def64fa77b3575720519d39.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Added Chinese (Simplified/Traditional) support.
[/list]

[h2]QoL Updates[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36386796/9713f0f039a2ae1bdfdc2b11d6531defe05ec2f9.png[/img]
[list]
[*]The Room feature is now available in online play.
Players can now browse an existing list of rooms to join, as well as set up their own rooms for matching.
Hosts can set public/private settings to their rooms, as well as add passwords.

[*]New graphics settings added to menu
[list]
[*]Default: Default graphics setting.
[*]Low: Shadows and some effects are disabled, making it lighter than the Normal option.
[*]Very Low: Rendering is set to the lowest level, with outlines disabled.
All Shots are set to a simple style, and some aspects of visual customization on Shots will not display. This is the lowest graphic option.
[/list]
Under the Very Low settings, we've tested a lower-end computer (Intel HD Graphics 620, screen resolution 1280x720) and found that it runs at about 50fps or more.
(*We cannot guarantee results for hardware without graphic cards; depending on your hardware's specifications, the game may not run smoothly.)
[*]Players can now move during the Ready phase.
[/list]

[h2]Balance adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*]Dash, Jump Dash, and Jump Cancel can no longer be interrupted mid-way due to damage.
[*]Tweaked damage calculation formula.
[*]Tweaked result score calculation.
[*]Stun time during Guard has been modified.
[*]Vertical (Y-axis) homing of bullets has been adjusted.
[*]The strength of dynamic curvature for bullet trajectories during homing has been adjusted.

[/list]

notes.title: Shot Creators Contest - Final Winners Revealed!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
we're happy to announce the final winners of the Shot Creators Contest!

With so many strong candidates, it was a difficult task choosing the best Shots among them all. The nominated entries were reviewed for a variety of details according to their category, and after careful consideration, we've ended up with the final list of winners.
Take a look!

[previewyoutube=Wu81SnLaVJA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Master Wizard Award[/h2]
Awarded to the overall top-tier Shot for both combat use and visuals.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36386796/e0097b4c1c83ddca3e13f67002d539b7b38931bb.png[/img]
[h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2003172298]Apollo11 (Creator: ビビドニアは　いいぞ)[/url][/h3]
This Shot takes its cues from the Apollo 11 mission, with its rocket shape and colors reminiscent of a certain brand of chocolate- also inspired by its namesake!
This Shot is not only visually and conceptually solid, it's trajectory also lends it accuracy that makes it battle-ready.
Congratulations on winning overall for the Shot Creators Contest!

[h2]Silver Bullet Award[/h2]
For the best technical, combat-oriented Shot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36386796/41b8afa75a796800d32416b00f29a826a03ee3b8.png[/img]
[h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2007542533]CrossRain (Creator : sisurface) [/url][/h3]
This tricky Shot assails opponents with an bullets flying in from different angles and speeds.
It's a very solid damage dealer that's hard to avoid, trapping and herding opponents with its array of bullets that box-in towards its target.
Easy to use in most any situation, this Shot is a combat essential!

[h2]Art of Magic Award[/h2]
For the most visually outstanding Shot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36386796/4a9a7dc5c5d4f1b4254fbff5795f91eb26683c5f.png[/img]
[h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2007029159]MeasuringWorm (Creator : Graen21011)[/url][/h3]
It's a.....WORM!
This Shot's faithful rendition of an animated, inching worm astounded us with its creative use of the Shot Development system. 
It's motif, uniqueness, and creativity helped inch its way to the top for it's artistry! 

[h2]Community Choice Award[/h2]
For the most subscribed Shot on the Steam Workshop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36386796/c5d58eaffbe653fccbe1017570178229777e1ca0.png[/img]
[h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2003661430]Magnum (Creator : cunha)[/url][/h3]
This Shot was the most subscribed as of the deadline for the Shot Creator's Contest!

[h3]Honourable Mentions[/h3]
For all Shots worth special mention:
[list]
[*] Nominated entries for each category that did not make the final cut
[*] Top-subscribed Shots in the workshop
[*] 3 Shots selected by judges for special nomination
[/list]

[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2010358333]RapidArch (Creator : lantastic79)[/url]

notes.title: Shot Creators Contest begins from 2/20/20!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36386796/886baba1dc41e3925c4ca6e903db01cb6fb4e992.jpg[/img]

Hey there, Shot Crafters!
[h3]The Shot Creators Contest starts from 2/2/20![/h3]
In this contest, user-made Shots uploaded to Steam Workshop will be judged based on several different categories. 
Nominees will be in the running for some special prizes!

Please note that we will only be accepting[b] 3 Shot entries per person[/b].
If you upload more, only the newest 3 Shots will be counted for the contest.
For more details, please check the Contest Rules in the main contest image above.

[h3]How to Participate[/h3][olist][*] Create an original Shot in Ballistic Craft.
[*] Be sure to add ‘SCC’ to the end of the Shot’s name.
(This can also be done after uploading to Steam Workshop.)
[*] Upload your Shot to Steam Workshop from the game’s main menu.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36386796/64fa468177054202325ba4acaa6bdeebaee9e8f1.jpg[/img]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2001499583]You can see the sample Shot here.

We're looking forward to seeing all of your awesome Shots! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Ballistic Craft, now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello Crafters!
We're happy to announce that Ballistic Craft has officially been released!
The "Bullet Hell of Your Own Making" magical arena battle game is out now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36386796/5edbc187f3daa2af965cb19fb379b23a894285e8.png[/img]
We suggest starting with single-player Quest Mode to get acquainted with the battle system.
Through Quest Mode, you can unlock new Shots (which you can use as-is or as easy templates for your own custom Shots), as well as other equipment and stages that you can unlock for Battle Mode!

In multiplayer Battle Mode, you can battle online with friends and other players across the globe.
Put your skills to the test and show off your own custom Shots!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36386796/76facb09483b8cc2cda49d6e634a14be18fc3674.gif[/img]
And the more you battle, the more you'll see how Shots affect the course of the fight.
What would happen if your Shot had more bullets, or if it were faster, or had an unpredictable trajectory?
Through the Shot Development feature, you can put these ideas to the test.
Use the learning helper to get started -- once you learn the controls, crafting complicated shots comes naturally.

[previewyoutube=OkKguPncbNw;full][/previewyoutube]
Time to Get Crafting!
We'll also be holding the Shot Creators Contest starting February 20th, 2020.
User-made Shots uploaded to Steam Workshop will be judged based on different categories, and participants will be in the running for some special prizes!

Further details on the contest and how to participate will soon be announced here on Steam, as well as on GameTomo's official twitter!

[url=https://twitter.com/GameTomoEN]@GameTomoEN[/url]

notes.title: Ballistic Craft Launches February 13th!
notes.content:
Hey future Crafters,
We just officially announced the Ballistic Craft release date, it's February 13th!
It will also be available at a launch-week discount of 10 percent off until February 20th.

We are so happy to announce the release date, since the game has been developed over the years! 
Here’s a little bit of behind-the-scenes information about the development of Ballistic Craft:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36386796/79d0a71f66e63f82c47eb958093a9b0871ce90b4.gif[/img]

[h3]1. What was the reason for developing the game?[/h3]
For a long time, the developers at Palladium Soft thought it would be really interesting and fun to be able to customize the movements of an attack from the ground up for a battle arena game.
And then one day they decided to make that system for real- and the end result was Ballistic Craft.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36386796/e74060253576061eca8b39fb2af51c86d2603756.gif[/img]

[h3]2. What were some goals in development?[/h3]
While developing, maintaining the balance of freedom for customization and its influence in battle was extremely important.
At first, a system where users could just have fun making the wildest Shots to share on social media was considered, but this would make it very difficult to balance the battling portion.
So instead, a functioning 'unlimited' version of the Shot Development system was developed first, with progressive adjustments made to Shot features that seemed to be too overpowered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36386796/49980cb0151b63d16c7454056134df39dc99bbdc.gif[/img]

[h3]3.What kind of influence has Ballistic Craft had from other games of the genre? How does it compare and contrast?[/h3]
Compared to other games in this genre, Ballistic Craft allows great freedom for customizing Shot trajectories, but is also a little lacking in 'smart' behaviors; the Shots don't have as many options for tricky, autonomous movements.
Due to this, it allows the battles to move at a much higher pace, with players putting aside anxious mind-games in order to intuitively react to the flow of battle.

We are planning various events for the launch so stay tuned for more updates.
